name: Sparse Voxel Octree Attribute Encoding (Neighbor)
definition: Encode the attribute of a sparse voxel octree into deltas from its neighbors.
summary: Sparse Voxel Octree Attribute Encoding (Neighbor) compresses volumetric data by encoding attribute deltas relative to spatially adjacent neighbors, distinguishing itself from parent-based methods by leveraging direct 3D spatial coherence.
